lead.headline: Done at 126.44: Nacua and Kyren Williams need 52 tonight
lead.deck: Tate's one catch was Houston's pass rush by his coach's account, Golden scored 20.3 on your bench, and Barkley may be back for Week 6.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Carnell Tate caught one of five targets for 1.6; on Monday Robert Saleh named no injury and said Houston's front 'took him away'. Matthew Golden, the coin flip behind him, scored 20.3 on your bench. Colston Loveland scored 3.9 from two backup quarterbacks while Brenton Strange, swapped out for him, scored 13.8, and Ben Johnson would not confirm Caleb Williams for Atlanta. The Jaguars' defence lost its stream to the Ravens by 4. Rashee Rice has nothing new and Kansas City put Tyquan Thornton on injured reserve. The better news: Nick Sirianni is 'hopeful' Saquon Barkley plays in Week 6. The result so far: you are finished at 126.44, and Kings of the North have 74.54 with Puka Nacua and Kyren Williams, projected 39.6 together, still to play Buffalo. Neither is on the Rams' final report. They need 51.9; ESPN gives you 74%.
